胡九郎一愣，随后说道：

“还是看一看吧！”

杨童果断摇头。

“不必了，没有必要，好了，不要被任何事情分心！”

杨树远抿了抿嘴唇。

“我会尽力帮你们护法，帮你们缓解禁咒的反噬之力，尽量减少你们受到的伤害。”

胡九郎拉着杨童，走到聚阴阵的凹槽旁边，两人并肩站在一起，神色坚定。胡九郎深吸一口气，缓缓说道：

“等一下我催动禁咒的时候，你一定要紧紧跟着我的气息，不要分心，无论感受到什么痛苦，都不要放弃，知道吗？”

“嗯！”

杨童点了点头，握紧他的手。

胡九郎闭上眼睛，深吸一口气，开始调整自己的气息，杨树远走到两人身边，闭上眼睛，双手结印，口中念念有词，周身泛起淡淡的白光，一股祥和的气息，笼罩着胡九郎和杨童，试图缓解禁咒即将带来的反噬之力。

李二牛、范梦雪、苏笑笑、阡陌和冷欣，纷纷分散开来，守护在正房的四周，目光警惕地观察着四周的动静，手中紧握着法器，随时准备应对突发情况，防止夏未来的手下前来偷袭。

汐汐则躲在正房的角落，紧紧攥着驱邪符箓，眼神紧张地看着胡九郎和杨童，默默为他们祈祷。

余元山站在正房的门口，目光警惕地望向后山的方向，神色严肃。

庭院里渐渐安静下来，只剩下杨树远念诵术法的声音，还有胡九郎和杨童平稳的呼吸声。

聚阴阵凹槽里的黑色污渍，依旧泛着淡淡的黑气，周围的符文在月光的照射下，显得愈发诡异，仿佛在抗拒着禁咒的力量。

胡九郎缓缓睁开眼睛，眼中闪过一丝精光，轻声说道：“准备好了吗？我们开始了。”

杨童也睁开眼睛，眼神坚定地看着他，应道：

“准备好了，开始吧。”

胡九郎深吸一口气，口中念念有词，凌空划出一道符篆，金光瞬间暴涨，朝着聚阴阵的凹槽，缓缓拍了下去。

与此同时，杨童也催动体内的真炁，紧紧跟着胡九郎的气息，将真炁注入胡九郎的掌心，共同催动着“清阴禁咒”。

金光落在聚阴阵的凹槽上，瞬间与凹槽里的黑色黑气交织在一起，发出“滋滋”的声响，黑色的黑气，在金光的灼烧下，渐渐消融，周围的阴邪之气，也开始慢慢消散。

杨树远依旧闭着眼睛，双手结印，口中念念有词，周身的白光越来越浓郁，不断滋养着胡九郎和杨童的身体。

众人依旧坚守在自己的岗位上，目光警惕地观察着四周的动静，不敢有丝毫松懈。他们知道禁咒的催动，需要一段时间，在这段时间里，他们必须守护好胡九郎和杨童，不能让任何意外发生。

夜色依旧深沉，后山的方向，依旧笼罩着淡淡的阴邪之气，仿佛有一双眼睛，在暗处默默观察着这一切。

Hu Jiulang was stunned for a moment, then said:

"Let's take a look!"

Yang Tong shook his head decisively.

"No, there's no need. Okay, don't be distracted by anything!"

Yang Shuyuan pursed his lips.

"I will try my best to help you protect the law, help you alleviate the backlash of the forbidden spell, and minimize the harm you receive."

Hu Jiulang pulled Yang Tong and walked to the groove of the Yin Gathering Formation. The two stood side by side with firm expressions.Hu Jiulang took a deep breath and said slowly:

"When I activate the forbidden spell later, you must follow my breath closely and don't get distracted. No matter how much pain you feel, don't give up. Do you understand?"

"Yeah!"

Yang Tong nodded and held his hand.

Hu Jiulang closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and began to adjust his breath. Yang Shuyuan walked to the two of them, closed his eyes, formed a seal with his hands, and muttered something in his mouth. A faint white light appeared around him, and a peaceful aura enveloped Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong, trying to alleviate the backlash of the forbidden curse.

Li Erniu, Fan Mengxue, Su Xiaoxiao, Qian Mo and Leng Xin dispersed one after another to guard the surroundings of the main room, observing the surroundings with vigilant eyes and holding the magic weapon tightly in their hands, ready to deal with emergencies at any time to prevent Xia Future's men from sneak attacks.

Xixi hid in the corner of the main room, clutching the exorcism talisman tightly, looking at Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong nervously, and silently praying for them.

Yu Yuanshan stood at the door of the main house, looking warily in the direction of the back hill with a serious expression.

The courtyard gradually became quiet, with only the sound of Yang Shuyuan reciting spells, and the steady breathing of Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong.

The black stains in the grooves of the Yin Gathering Formation still glowed with a faint black air. Under the moonlight, the surrounding runes looked increasingly weird, as if they were resisting the power of the forbidden spell.

Hu Jiulang slowly opened his eyes, a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes, and said softly: "Are you ready? Let's start."

Yang Tong also opened his eyes, looked at him firmly, and responded:

"Ready, let's begin."

Hu Jiulang took a deep breath, muttered something in his mouth, and drew a talisman in the air. The golden light suddenly surged and slowly shot towards the groove of the Yin Gathering Formation.

At the same time, Yang Tong also activated the true energy in his body, followed Hu Jiulang's breath closely, and injected the true energy into Hu Jiulang's palm, and together they activated the "Qingyin Forbidden Curse".

The golden light fell on the groove of the Yin Gathering Formation, and instantly intertwined with the black air in the groove, making a "sizzling" sound. The black air gradually melted under the burning of the golden light, and the surrounding Yin and evil energy also began to slowly dissipate.

Yang Shuyuan still closed his eyes, formed seals with his hands, and muttered words in his mouth. The white light around him became more and more intense, constantly nourishing the bodies of Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong.

Everyone still sticks to their posts, watching the movements around them with vigilant eyes, not daring to relax at all.They knew that it would take some time for the forbidden spell to be activated. During this period, they had to protect Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong and not let any accidents happen.

The night was still dark, and the direction of the back mountain was still shrouded in a faint evil atmosphere, as if there were a pair of eyes silently observing all this in the dark.
